Which kinds of medical equipment and supplies cost Medicare the most?
Medicare Durable Medical Equipment Devices Supplies By Geography And Service

SELECT hcpcs_desc AS item, round(sum(try_cast(tot_suplr_srvcs AS double) * try_cast(avg_suplr_mdcr_pymt_amt AS double))) AS medicare_paid FROM govblock_health.medicare_durable_medical_equipment_devices_supplies_by_geography_and_service WHERE rfrg_prvdr_geo_lvl = 'National' AND source_file = (SELECT max(source_file) FROM govblock_health.medicare_durable_medical_equipment_devices_supplies_by_geography_and_service) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Did Apple or Samsung Electronics receive more U.S. patents in 2021?

SELECT a.disambig_assignee_organization, count(DISTINCT p.patent_id) AS patents FROM govblock_patents.pv_g_patent p JOIN govblock_patents.pv_g_assignee_disambiguated a ON a.patent_id = p.patent_id WHERE p.patent_date LIKE '2021%' AND a.disambig_assignee_organization IN ('Apple Inc.', 'Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd.') GROUP BY 1 LIMIT 10
Which states drew the most from the Unemployment Trust Fund in 2020?

SELECT acct_desc AS state, abs(sum(try_cast(shares_per_par AS double))) AS withdrawn FROM govblock_treasury.utf_account_statement WHERE report_type = 'State' AND trans_desc_cd LIKE '21-10%' AND substr(cast(eff_date AS varchar), 1, 4) = '2020' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much did Medicare pay for longer office visits (code 99214) in New York in 2019?
Medicare Physician Other Practitioners By Geography And Service

SELECT round(sum(try_cast(tot_srvcs AS double) * try_cast(avg_mdcr_pymt_amt AS double))) AS medicare_paid FROM govblock_health.medicare_physician_other_practitioners_by_geography_and_service WHERE rndrng_prvdr_geo_lvl = 'State' AND rndrng_prvdr_geo_desc = 'New York' AND hcpcs_cd = '99214' AND source_file LIKE '%D19_Geo%'
Which countries' funders are acknowledged on the most PubMed papers?
SELECT country, count(DISTINCT pmid) AS papers FROM govblock_health.pubmed_grants WHERE country <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much did a winning House candidate raise on average in the 2022 cycle?
SELECT avg(ttl_receipts) AS average FROM govblock_fec.candidate_summary WHERE cast(cycle AS varchar) = '2022' AND cast(gen_election AS varchar) = 'W' AND cand_id LIKE 'H%'
Which reliability regions had the most units reporting to EPA in 2023?
SELECT nerc_region, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_environment.campd_facility_attributes WHERE year = 2023 AND nerc_region IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many reverse mortgages were made in 2023?
SELECT count(*) AS reverse_mortgages FROM govblock_finance.hmda_lar WHERE cast(activity_year AS varchar) = '2023' AND cast(action_taken AS varchar) = '1' AND cast(reverse_mortgage AS varchar) = '1'
In which years was the most coal-fired generating capacity retired?
Eia860 Generator Y Retired And Canceled

SELECT retirement_year, round(sum(mw)) AS retired_mw FROM (SELECT retirement_year, plant_code, generator_id, max(try_cast(nameplate_capacity_mw AS double)) AS mw FROM govblock_energy.eia860_generator_y_sheet_retired_and_canceled WHERE status = 'RE' AND energy_source_1 IN ('BIT', 'SUB', 'LIG', 'RC', 'WC') GROUP BY 1, 2, 3) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many drug and disease pairings have reached approval?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_drug_indication WHERE max_phase_for_ind = 4
Which compounds go by the most synonyms in PubChem?

SELECT t.c1 AS compound, count(*) AS synonyms FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_synonym_filtered AS s JOIN govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_title AS t ON t.c0 = s.c0 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How sharply did layoffs jump between February and March 2020?
SELECT period, value AS layoffs_thousands FROM govblock_labor.bls_jt_data WHERE series_id = 'JTS000000000000000LDL' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2020' AND period IN ('M02', 'M03') ORDER BY period
Which genes or proteins are named in the most chemistry patents?

SELECT e.corrected_text AS gene_or_protein, count(DISTINCT l.patent_id) AS patents FROM govblock_chemistry.surechembl_biomedical_locations AS l JOIN govblock_chemistry.surechembl_biomedical_entities AS e ON cast(e.id AS varchar) = cast(l.entity_id AS varchar) JOIN govblock_chemistry.surechembl_biomedical_types AS t ON cast(t.id AS varchar) = cast(e.type_id AS varchar) WHERE t.type_name = 'GeneOrProtein' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did the average installed price per watt of residential solar change from 2010 to 2022?

SELECT substr(cast(installation_date AS varchar), 1, 4) AS year, round(avg(try_cast(total_installed_price AS double) / (try_cast(pv_system_size_dc AS double) * 1000)), 2) AS dollars_per_watt FROM govblock_energy.oedi_tracking_the_sun WHERE customer_segment = 'RES' AND try_cast(total_installed_price AS double) > 0 AND try_cast(pv_system_size_dc AS double) > 0 AND substr(cast(installation_date AS varchar), 1, 4) IN ('2010', '2022') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which chemical systems have the most computed materials?
SELECT chemsys, count(*) AS materials FROM govblock_materials.mp_summary GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did the number of EPA enforcement cases change from fiscal 2000 to fiscal 2010?
SELECT cast(fiscal_year AS varchar) AS year, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_environment.echo_case_enforcements WHERE cast(fiscal_year AS varchar) IN ('2000', '2010') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
What are the tallest wind turbines in California?
SELECT p_name, t_model, try_cast(t_ttlh AS double) AS total_height_m FROM govblock_energy.wind_uswtdb_uswtdb_v WHERE t_state = 'CA' ORDER BY 3 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
What is the longest patent term adjustment the USPTO has granted?
SELECT max(try_cast(patent_term_adjustment AS double)) AS most_days FROM govblock_patents.patex_pta_summary_25
Which reactors ran at the lowest average power in 2023?
SELECT trim(unit) AS reactor, round(avg(try_cast(power AS double)), 1) AS avg_pct_power FROM govblock_reactors.nrc_power_status WHERE reportdt LIKE '%/2023 %' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 ASC LIMIT 10
What share of reported fund holdings are options rather than shares?
SELECT coalesce(nullif(putcall, ''), 'Shares') AS kind, count(*) AS holdings FROM govblock_sec.sec_13f_infotable GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which construction trades carry the highest Davis-Bacon hourly wage rates on average?

SELECT classification, round(avg(try_cast(rate AS double)), 2) AS avg_rate FROM govblock_awards.sam_wd_dba_rates WHERE try_cast(rate AS double) BETWEEN 1 AND 200 GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*) >= 50 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many fatal crashes in 2022 involved a drunk driver?
SELECT count(*) AS crashes FROM govblock_vehicles.fars_accident WHERE cast(year AS varchar) = '2022' AND try_cast(drunk_dr AS integer) > 0
What kinds of opinion make up the archive: lead, concurring, dissenting?
SELECT type, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_courts.opinions WHERE type IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the highest combined rate ever paid on I bonds?
SELECT max(try_cast(combined_rate AS double)) AS highest_rate FROM govblock_treasury.i_bonds_interest_rates
Which recipients received the largest single grants in fiscal 2024?

SELECT recipient_name, try_cast(total_obligation AS double) AS obligated FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_db_rpt_award_search WHERE category = 'grant' AND cast(fiscal_year AS varchar) = '2024' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How often does the Texas regulator confirm an insurance complaint?
SELECT finding_type, count(*) AS complaints FROM govblock_insurance_filings.tx_insurance_complaints GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which enforcement actions are taken most often against hazardous waste handlers?
SELECT enforcement_desc, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_environment.echo_rcra_enforcements WHERE enforcement_desc IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many Form 4 reports did Tesla insiders file in 2022?
SELECT count(*) AS filings FROM govblock_sec.sec_insider_submission WHERE issuertradingsymbol = 'TSLA' AND document_type = '4' AND filing_date LIKE '%-2022'
Which utilities earned the most revenue from commercial customers in 2020?

SELECT column02 AS utility, column06 AS state, try_cast(revenues_1 AS double) AS commercial_thousand_dollars FROM govblock_energy.eia861_sales_ult_cust_sheet_states WHERE column00 = '2020' AND column03 = 'A' ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
How many award recipients have a crosswalk from their old DUNS number to a UEI?
Which counties have the highest adult obesity rate?

SELECT concat(locationname, ', ', stateabbr) AS county, try_cast(data_value AS double) AS percent FROM govblock_health.cdc_places_county WHERE measureid = 'OBESITY' AND datavaluetypeid = 'AgeAdjPrv' AND year = '2022' ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
What did New York households on full service pay per kilowatt hour in 2020, on average?

SELECT round(100 * sum(try_cast(revenues AS double)) / sum(try_cast(sales AS double)), 2) AS cents_per_kwh FROM govblock_energy.eia861_sales_ult_cust_sheet_states WHERE column00 = '2020' AND column03 = 'A' AND column06 = 'NY'
Which occupations pay the highest median wage in the United States?

SELECT occ_title, try_cast(a_median AS double) AS median_pay FROM govblock_labor.oes_all_data_m_sheet_a WHERE area_title = 'U.S.' AND naics_title = 'Cross-industry' AND try_cast(a_median AS double) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many contract actions in fiscal year 2025 were set aside for service-disabled veteran-owned businesses?
SELECT count(*) AS actions FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_contracts WHERE action_date_fiscal_year = '2025' AND type_of_set_aside LIKE '%SERVICE-DISABLED%'
Which companies have received the most recorded patent assignments?
SELECT ee_name, count(*) AS assignments FROM govblock_patents.assign_assignee GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the most solar power California's grid has delivered in a single hour?

SELECT max(coalesce(try_cast(net_generation_mw_from_solar AS double), try_cast(net_generation_mw_from_solar_without_integrated_battery_storage AS double))) AS peak_solar_mw FROM govblock_solar.eia930_region WHERE balancing_authority = 'CISO'
Which utilities sold the most electricity to industrial customers in 2020?

SELECT column02 AS utility, column06 AS state, try_cast(sales_2 AS double) AS industrial_mwh FROM govblock_energy.eia861_sales_ult_cust_sheet_states WHERE column00 = '2020' AND column03 = 'A' ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
How many claims does a published patent application carry on average?
SELECT round(avg(try_cast(pub_clm_ct AS double)), 1) AS avg_claims FROM govblock_patents.claims_pgpub_document_stats
Which companies own or operate the most units in EPA's 2023 Clean Air Markets data?
SELECT owneroperator, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_environment.campd_facility_attributes WHERE year = 2023 AND owneroperator IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many fewer mortgage applications were there in 2010 than in 2007?
SELECT as_of_year, count(*) AS applications FROM govblock_finance.hmda_lar_2007_2017 WHERE cast(as_of_year AS varchar) IN ('2007', '2010') GROUP BY 1 LIMIT 10
